title: Patroni: cluster healthcheck
description: Runs `nexus health postgres`: single-leader, per-node Patroni state, replication lag, a TLS+scram round-trip via the VIP, authed etcd quorum, and HAProxy liveness.

observe.what: single-leader=1; each pg patroni-state green; replication-lag <=10 MB; vip-writable green (operator scram via .60 -> leader, recovery=false); etcd-quorum 3/3 authed; haproxy active

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.HealthAsync fuses patronictl, a genuine operator scram round-trip via the VIP, and an authenticated etcd endpoint-health into one health verdict.
